enchantments.tooltip: Spellcasting Implement +12: Passive: +12 Implement bonus to Universal Spell Power.
+4 Enhancement Bonus: +4 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Sonic Lore V: Passive: Your Sonic spells gain a 15% Equipment bonus to their chance to critical hit.
Resonance +66: Passive: +66 Equipment bonus to Sonic Spell Power.

Thundering: A thundering weapon creates a cacophonous roar when striking a successful critical hit. A thundering weapon deals an extra 1 to 8 points of sonic damage upon a successful critical hit with a weapon that has a x2 critical multiplier, an extra 2 to 16 for a x3 multiplier, and an extra 3 to 24 for x4 multiplier.
Stunning +8: +8 Enhancement bonus to the DC of character's Stunning Blow and Stunning Fist attempts.
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
